comment: Dr. Fairtile is always accessible outside of class for help. Though the reading materials can be difficult to understand, Dr. Fairtile is a great discussion leader and is very good at emphasizing important concepts. Also, feel free to send your papers before DDL to get some general feedback from her. If you're interested in opera, take her class!

I liked Dr. Fairtile's class. Class was straightforward, with reading or films to watch before and a group discussion during class time. Graded on 3 essays, a research assignment, a journal, participation, and presentation. The material was pretty interesting.

She's a really fair and good prof. I was completely new to opera and she managed to make it really enjoyable to learn and easy to follow. Her passion for the subject is clear, and really engaging. Lots of readings assigned but you don't really have to do them to pass. 4 papers total and she gives really good comments and chances for revisions.

If you want an enjoyable FYS I would highly recommend taking Staging Conflict! Staging Conflict is a wonderful class with not that much reading compared to other classes at all. This FYS is about Opera but it is really enjoyable class where you do get to take field trips to go see some shows! Participation matters but Dr. Fairtile is the best!
